title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Detour With You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After the after-party
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was so fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, to think it's evening already... I didn't expect we'd lose track of time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We were only supposed to join you for lunch, but we got carried away and stayed for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I had fun too. We need to say thank you to Ken for giving us the day off practice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was all the more fun since we all avoided being held back a year! I'm glad everything turned out alright in the end!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, we'd better not loiter around the diner entrance and cause trouble for the staff. How about we part ways here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here's to another year in school together, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Yup!
Yeah.
Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I'm headed this way! See you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, see you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was really annoyed when I got told I had to take supplementary classes, but the study sessions ended up being really fun thanks to the others.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hesitated when Rui invited me, but I'm glad I agreed to help out.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No one got held back in the end, and it feels like a weight off my shoulders...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I kinda feel like I've achieved something. Like I'm happy for the others.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh! I wonder if this is how a cram school teacher feels when their students pass a test?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It really was fun...
Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, An?! Why did you chase after me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, did I forget something at the diner?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nope! It's not that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, so... I have something for you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something for me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This! I got it as thanks for the notebook you made for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh... But, I didn't expect anything in return...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's fine! I don't know if you'll like it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you! I'm so surprised you got me something. What could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is this...lipstick? Wait, this is Dear Ribbon's newest shade!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yep. I thought it would look good on you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't know much about this stuff, so I wasn't super confident about it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, you did great! You remembered me saying I liked this brand, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And it's their newest product too! I love it!
Anyway, just knowing you put so much thought into picking this out makes me super happy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But, you could've given this to me at the after-party.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's not exactly on-brand for me to give a gift like this, y'know? I was feeling kinda shy about it, so I kept putting it off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And then I missed my chance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. So that's why you came running after me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, An! I'll treasure this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah. Since we're nearly there anyway, let me walk you to the station.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! Look, it's that shop!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The apple pie place we went to the other day?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wanna stop by? Remember, we promised we'd go again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What, already?! Besides, can you seriously eat after the feast we just had?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is that a no?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, why not! I'll get one too. There's always room for pie!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! Let's go in!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While we're at it, let's go check out some other places! After all, it feels like a waste to cut our last day as first-years short.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was thinking that too! Alright, let's have as much fun as we can today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & An
rows.Line: Yeah!
